record_title: Prime-power action images obstruct psi-divisibility in cyclic-by-cyclic groups
provenance: Scientific theorem, symbolic proof, exact finite verification, literature comparison, and review evidence only.
limitations: The result does not settle whether any nonabelian psi-divisible finite group exists.
For C_{p^alpha} semidirect C_n, the stated corollary leaves cases where the action image has at least two prime divisors and shares a prime divisor with the kernel size.
The exact gcd theorem assumes a cyclic p-power normal subgroup and a cyclic q-power complement with coprime primes.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the short deduction from a known semidirect-product formula could have an implicit or differently phrased antecedent.
